detail.description: Progressive Robot hMailServer 6.3.7 的 Windows 安装程序中未经验证的所有权允许本地经过身份验证的用户以邮件服务器的服务帐户或管理员身份运行代码，当安装程序安装到或升级管理员以外的帐户之前可以写入的程序文件夹时，例如预先在驱动器根目录中创建的文件夹。 6.3.7 通过授予程序文件夹、Bin 和 ControlPanel 权限（只有管理员可以更改）来修复 CVE-2026-107571，但安装程序拒绝它们中已有的任何内容，或者保存事件脚本、加载项和数据库脚本的文件夹中的任何内容：另一个帐户拥有的程序、库、脚本或设置文件，或者其自己的权限允许另一个帐户更改它，则由该所有者和这些权限保留，文件夹的强化不会采用这些权限离开。然后，安装程序以管理员的提升权限运行 Bin 中的程序，并且作为 LocalSystem 或其虚拟帐户运行的服务运行这些程序和事件脚本，以便加载放置在 Bin 中的此类帐户的库来代替系统的库；安装后该帐户仍然可以更改文件。 Program Files 下的默认安装不受影响。
detail.title: hMailServer 中未经验证的所有权

detail_original.description: Unverified ownership in the Windows installer of Progressive Robot hMailServer 6.3.7 allows a local authenticated user to run code as the mail server's service account or as an administrator when setup installs into, or upgrades, a program folder that accounts other than the administrators could write before, such as one made beforehand at the root of a drive. 6.3.7 fixed CVE-2026-107571 by giving the program folder, Bin and ControlPanel permissions that only administrators may change, but setup refused nothing that was already in them, or in the folders that hold the event script, the add-ons and the database scripts: a program, a library, a script or a settings file that another account owns, or whose own permissions let another account change it, is kept with that owner and those permissions, which the hardening of the folders does not take away. Setup then runs programs from Bin with the administrator's elevated rights, and the service, which runs as LocalSystem or as its virtual account, runs them and the event script, so that a library such an account placed in Bin is loaded in place of the system's; the account can still change the file after the installation. The default installation under Program Files is not affected.
detail_original.title: Unverified Ownership in hMailServer
